performance.verdict: SOW is 83 days overdue; no campaigns live means no money to judge yet.

findings.text: 10 of 10 overdue SOW milestones unmet as of 2026-10-19; earliest deadline was 2026-07-31, now 83 days past due. No Flow-managed campaigns are live.
CPL spiked 52.36% week-over-week on flat spend (+1.58%), from ~$6.73 to ~$10.28 blended; leads fell from ~18 to ~12 in last 7 days — efficiency is deteriorating.
3-day lead signal (Oct 16–18): 4+2+2=8 leads vs prior 3 days (Oct 13–15): 2+3+2=7 — flat volume, but CPL rising means each lead is costing more, not stabilizing.
MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP consumed $1,106.43 of $1,151.28 total 28-day spend (96%) with leads declining — single-campaign concentration with falling returns signals creative fatigue.
GBP actions dropped 20.83% week-over-week; last 3 days show 0+0+0 GBP actions, versus 1+7+10 in the prior 3-day window — organic demand signal has gone cold.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 10 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer and Sohib; no paid scaling until pre-launch stack test clears.
suggestions.monday_update: All 10 SOW milestones are overdue as of 2026-10-19, with the earliest 83 days past the 2026-07-31 deadline — including pre-launch stack test, GHL migration, Meta account & CAPI, and landing pages. No Flow-managed campaigns are live and no spend efficiency can be meaningfully evaluated until the stack test clears. Escalate to Nacer (Ops) and Sohib (Account) immediately for gate sign-off. Success check: at least the pre-launch stack test milestone confirmed complete by 2026-10-26.

suggestions.text: Introduce at least one new creative variant into MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP; current 96% spend concentration with 52.36% CPL rise confirms fatigue.
suggestions.monday_update: MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP has absorbed $1,106.43 of $1,151.28 in 28-day spend while CPL has risen 52.36% week-over-week — a classic single-creative fatigue pattern. Introduce at least one new Portuguese-first creative variant into this campaign, keeping compliance rules (no outcome guarantees, no PHI, Special Ad Category applied). Success check: CPL returns below $7.50 (prior 7-day implied baseline) within 7 days of the new variant going live. Re-check 2026-10-26.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions; 3 consecutive zero-action days (Oct 16–18) after prior 3-day average of 6 — confirm profile health before attributing to demand.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero for the last 3 consecutive days (Oct 16–18), down from a 3-day average of 6 actions in the prior window, and down 20.83% on the 7-day delta. This may indicate a GBP profile issue (suspension, edits pending review) rather than a pure demand drop — especially since the GBP triage milestone is also overdue per SOW. No paid action warranted; verify profile status on all MedStation Weston GBP listings. Re-check and report back by 2026-10-22.
